contexts.text: Under Door, see these references. AE 208. AE 208:4.
He shut the door after him () = lest they should do violence to the good of charity, and deny the Divine Human and the Holy proceeding of the Lord.
For the door was the inner door through which there was entrance into the house where the Angels were; that is, into the good in which is the Lord.

They approached to break down the door () = that they came even to the endeavour to destroy both. (For) the door = that which introduces to good and to the Lord; also good itself, and the Lord Himself.
They shut the door () = that He closes all approach to them.

The door of the inner gate that looketh towards the north () = the place where there are interior falsities; the door of the gate of the house of Jehovah towards the north = where there are interior evils.

(Tamar) sat in the door of the fountains which are upon the way to Timnath () = an intermediate to the truths of the Church and to falsities... In the door of them = in the entrance to them; and as the external truths which are of the sense of the letter of the Word afford an entrance, they are the door.

They spake to him at the door of the house () = consultation from doctrinal things about introduction... The door of the house = introduction; here, from the external man to the internal... As this is signified, in the Original Language, it is not said at the door of the house, but the door of the house.
Under Bedchamber, see this reference.
To go out from the door of the house () = to go from good to truth; for good is within and truth without.
When truths are only known, they are as it were in the door; when they are acknowledged, they are in the court...

Lift up your heads, ye gates; be ye lift up, ye doors of the world (). To lift up the doors of the world = to open and raise hearts to the Lord... and thus give communication, that is, that He may flow in with the good of charity and the truth of faith.
Thou shalt make a hanging for the door of the Tent () = the medium uniting the Second Heaven with the First... The entrance from one into the other, is signified by the door where the hanging was.

Thou shalt make (Aaron and his sons) approach the door of the Tent of the Assembly () = the conjunction of both in Heaven... The door = introduction... For the place where was the door of the Tent of the Assembly represented the marriage of Divine good with Divine truth. Explained. AC 10025.
The place before the Tent, which is called its door, = the conjunction of truth and good, which is called the heavenly marriage.
At the door of the Tent of the Assembly () = in order to enter into Heaven. A door = entrance, and also introduction. References.

All the people arose, and stood at the door of the Tent () = that that nation was not in the external of the Word, of the Church, and of worship, but outside of it... For a door = entrance, introduction, and communication; hence to stand before it = not to enter, be introduced, and be communicated. AC 10553.
These outlets and entrances are what are called in the Word the gates and the doors of Hell and of Heaven.
The door () = entrance into Heaven.
When they arrive at the cavern, a door is opened, and they enter... and the door is shut behind them.
Behold, I have set before thee an open door () = that Heaven is open to those who are in truths from good from the Lord. An open door = intromission. AE 208.
Doors, etc., in the Word, = entrance. Illustrated.
To open the door = to live according to the Word. ( = reception in the heart and life. AE 250.)
Behold, a door open in Heaven () = manifestation concerning the ordination of the Heavens for the Last Judgment by the Lord. An open door, when said of Heaven, = intromission; here, manifestation.
There is the door through which the Lord enters to man...
Everything compulsory in such things... shuts up the spiritual man as with a door...
The eastern door of the gate of the house () = approach (to Heaven and the Church).
There appears a gate with a door at the side where there are guards.

A door, etc. to Heaven and the Church, in the supreme sense, means the Lord... I am the Door of the sheep; by Me if anyone shall enter in, he shall be saved... (). To enter by the Door, here, = to enter by the Lord. Explained... He, therefore, who approaches the Lord, acknowledges Him, and believes in Him, is said to open the door to the Lord,in, Behold, I stand at the door, and knock... Something shall here be said about the doors or gates to man, because it is said I stand at the door, and knock.
To open the door = reception on the part of man.

Behold, I stand at the door and knock = the Lord's perpetual presence. (For) a door or door in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to intromission into Heaven or into the Church; and, in the internal sense, the truth from good which is from Him, because man is intromitted thereby.
If he thinks well, the door is opened; if evilly, it is shut.
And shall open the door = life, or reception in the heart.
1.2. Behold, a door open in Heaven = the arcana of Heaven revealed. A door = intromission; here, introspection, which is the intromission of the sight...
The door of Pharaoh's house () = the sensuous scientific, through which there is entrance into the natural man...
